title: Crop Insurance Conditions of Application, Renewal, Coverage Change and Cancellation
content:
**Condition 1 — signing.** An application for Crop Insurance, or a change of plan or coverage level for the coming crop year, must be signed by the sales closing date of the crop year; a continuous policy renews each year at the same coverage unless the member changes it by the coverage change deadline or cancels it in writing by the cancellation date, a cancellation received later taking effect for the following crop year.

**Condition 2 — acceptance.** The provider accepts the application on its terms; the association's agency never binds coverage the provider has not accepted.

**Condition 3 — ineligible members.** A member made ineligible by a termination for indebtedness cannot apply until that debt is paid.

## The record from application to acceptance or cancellation

- An application is signed for one crop in one county for a crop year. The record shows the plan and coverage level applied for, the crop, the county and state, the crop year, the practice, the unit structure elected, the APH yield, the projected price for the crop year, whether beginning farmer status is certified, and the signature date. A new record stands in **applied** status.
- An applied record becomes **active** when the insurance provider accepts the application signed by the sales closing date; the acceptance date and the provider's policy number are recorded.
- An applied record becomes **cancelled** when the member withdraws the application before the sales closing date.
- An active record becomes **cancelled** when the member cancels the continuous policy in writing by the cancellation date, effective for the next crop year. The cancellation records the date it takes effect.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, using the sales closing date and cancellation date of the product's calendar)

| Event | Date | Result under the conditions |
|---|---|---|
| Application signed | on the sales closing date itself | signed by the sales closing date |
| Application signed | the day after the sales closing date | not signed by the sales closing date |
| Change of plan or coverage level signed | on the coverage change deadline | changed for the coming crop year |
| No change signed by the coverage change deadline, no cancellation | — | the continuous policy renews at the same coverage |
| Written cancellation received | on the cancellation date | cancelled by the cancellation date |
| Written cancellation received | the day after the cancellation date | received later; takes effect for the following crop year |

## Basis Q&A

*Is a Crop Insurance policy in force once the agency has taken the signed application?* No. The provider accepts the application on its terms, and the agency never binds coverage the provider has not accepted; the record is active only from the provider's acceptance.

*Must a continuous policy be re-applied for each year?* No. It renews each year at the same coverage unless the member changes it by the coverage change deadline or cancels it in writing by the cancellation date.

*May a member whose earlier policy was terminated for indebtedness sign a new application?* Not until that debt is paid.
